d.en: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.
d.zh: 开设您自己的卡牌商店。摆放最新的补充包，也可以拆开收集卡牌。自行定价、雇佣员工、举办活动，并拓展您的卡牌商店。
